In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] offensive prior to [[Operation Shadow Hand]], after driving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Imperial forces pursued the retreating New Republic along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and '''attacked''' [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].
